K000403.bio: Mike Kennedy is a Republican U.S. Representative for Utah's 3rd congressional district, in office since 2025. Kennedy was elected in 2026 as a Republican U.S. Representative for Utah's 4th congressional district, taking office on January 3, 2027. Kennedy worked as a lawyer and physician.
